author: Bobby Grayson
title: Second gap in the supervisor liveness statement: with h0 : ρ.st 0 = init and closed Sys runs (no environment), the worker never dies (it exits only on :crash/:stop, which only the environment sends), so the premise 'child dead at t' is never met along a run from init. Same closedness already affects the safety theorem restart_in_flight (SysReach init has no dead child). Fix: state restart_eventually from any Good start state (Inv ∧ NoKillTo 0), prove Good closed under environment deliveries and SysReachEnv init ⊆ Good; keep the init form as a corollary. Runs with environment steps interleaved are left for a later round (recorded).
